fact: The Partnership Compact of December 2023 says the education sector plan SDEF 2021-2035 provides for strengthening the ministry's current SIGE (GOSE) to cover the most vulnerable pupils and for a digital SIGE integrating HR, geolocation and learning management.
title: Pacte de Partenariat, Djibouti
publisher: Ministere de l'Education Nationale et de la Formation Professionnelle / GPE
